name: const unsafe fn byte_offset_from_unsigned < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : * const U) -> usize
rule: For `byte_offset_from_unsigned` to be safe, `self` must be equal to or greater than `origin`; for non-`Sized` pointees, this requirement concerns only their data pointers, ignoring metadata.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * const T { const unsafe fn byte_offset_from_unsigned < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : * const U) -> usize }
